Comments: Uganda's internet penetration approximately 40-45%. Digital government services accessible primarily to literate, connected populations. No specific accessibility features for disabled/elderly confirmed in data exchange documentation.

revision_notes: The original comment's '40-45%' internet penetration figure is not supported: DataReportal puts Uganda internet penetration at 28.0% (Jan 2025) falling to 22.0% (end 2025), while World Bank/ITU data shows an even lower 8.95% (2024) — sources disagree sharply on methodology. No specific disability/elderly accessibility provisions in the data exchange were found either way. Given the comment's factual basis is wrong but no authoritative evidence clearly supports a different code on this specific variable, code is left unchanged (2) but flagged for human review given the substantial connectivity-data discrepancy.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection and Privacy Act enacted (referenced in e-GIF as legal basis for data protection in government data exchange). e-GIF includes data sovereignty principles. NITA-U manages national data center infrastructure. Provisions exist but enforcement capacity developing.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: In July 2025 Uganda's Personal Data Protection Office issued its first major enforcement action, ordering Google to register as a data controller/processor and account for cross-border transfers under the 2019 Act — evidence enforcement capacity is developing beyond 2022. However, the same ruling explicitly declined to order data localisation, so full 'strong, enforced' controls (level 4) are not yet demonstrated. Code left unchanged (3) but flagged for human review given the meaningful, dated (2022) Value Year and the fresh enforcement evidence.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: e-GIF v2 is mandatory for all MDAs and Local Governments (LGs). 80 MDAs with 336 information systems registered. e-GIF explicitly covers district/local government level. Partial but broad participation documented; full participation not yet achieved.
redteam_note: Comment wording may not match the score — re-read (needs judgement).
revision_notes: The comment conflates e-GIF's mandatory policy coverage of Local Governments with actual technical participation. A 2024 DIAL case study, citing a 2022 national ICT survey, found ICT adoption among local governments/districts remains 'strikingly low' (under 5%), and only 47 of 113-150 UgHub-onboarded entities are government MDAs at all (most others are private banks/fintechs), with no separately confirmed LG onboarding figures. This does not support 'Partial Participation' (4) at sub-national level specifically. Lowered to Under development (3) to reflect that LG participation is still nascent despite the national mandate.
